summary: Full e2e testing of Deepesh Agrawal portfolio (backend + frontend). 9/9 backend pytest tests pass and all critical frontend flows verified: sections render, sticky nav scroll, hero CTAs, resume.pdf download, contact form happy + sad paths persisting to MongoDB, mobile drawer with 9 links.

minor.issue: server.py uses `logger` inside the route at line 84, but `logger` is initialized at line 109 (below `app.include_router`). It works because Python resolves module-level names lazily at call time, but it's a latent bug - if the exception branch were hit during a module reorganization it could NameError. Move logger init above the routes.

action_items: (Low) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above the route definitions in /app/backend/server.py to avoid a latent NameError risk in the contact insert exception branch.
(Low) Consider cleaning up TEST_ prefixed contact_messages periodically; tests insert real DB rows on each run.
critical_code_review_comments: logger used before assignment in server.py: define logger at top of file (after imports) before api_router routes are declared.
/api/contact has no rate limiting / captcha - public POST endpoint can be spammed. Acceptable for an MVP portfolio but worth noting.
Backend stores `created_at` as ISO string (not BSON date). Sort works because ISO 8601 sorts lexicographically, but for proper date ops switching to native datetime would be cleaner.

CORS uses allow_origins='*' AND allow_credentials=True - browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origins. Currently no credentialed calls are made so this is benign, but the combination is inconsistent.
test_credentials: n/a - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_-prefixed rows into contact_messages and status_checks collections. Not cleaned up automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py (pytest). Public base URL pulled from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend uses data-testid extensively (hero-*, nav-link-*, nav-mobile-link-*, contact-input-*, contact-submit-btn, contact-form, hero-section, sections by id: home/about/expertise/current-role/experience/projects/skills/education/certifications/contact).
